items.label: POP QUIZ
items.problem: its header says 3,584 bytes and the block holds 512
items.why: the boot program in the KERNAL format: Novaload, which points the LOAD vector at $0330 to its own routine at $033C and loads the rest of the tape with it (orientation.md, The loader)

items.label: turbo block 2 "0"
items.why: the loading picture, a multicolour bitmap at $1000-$3F3F that Novaload shows while the program loads; the game loads over it, and the Graphics tab draws it from these bytes (test_loading_picture.js)

items.label: turbo block 3 "3"
items.why: the program from $4200 to $CFFF: equal byte for byte to the title listing with the menu part over $4F00-$53FF and $B800-$CFFF, the ranges the menu part lays over the title (work/f3diff.js)

items.label: turbo block 12 "D"
items.why: a file of question blocks 2 to 5 (D, G, J and M load at $E000 and the game copies them to $D000; E, H, K and N at $B800; F, I, L and O at $E000), the same layout as block 1, which the quiz listing holds; the Questions tab lists every question of the five blocks, and the Play tab loads these files when a block is chosen (reference/pq-blocks.js, whose hashes test_play.js checks)
